theorem: For a stationary equilibrium state with Killing-aligned flow, phi=0, no coherent incoming bath displacement and no direct ordinary-sector charge, the full spectral influence action, diagonal counterterms and induced bath stress have zero first variation beyond the already-counted T_X; the metric equation is the selected EH equation.
Maxwell_source: standard Hilbert stress including Poynting flux
scope: stationary classical mean-field local branch; excludes coherent bath excitations, stochastic metric variance, strong field and the time-dependent clock sector
